explanation: The gateway device registration now uses `api.smile_model` and `api.smile_name` from the new library version (0.25.0) instead of the hardcoded `f'Smile {api.smile_name}'` and `entry.title`, meaning if the new library returns unexpected values or the attributes don't exist, the device name/model displayed in HA will be wrong or cause an AttributeError.
